name: William Shakespeare
biography: English playwright, poet and actor, often called England's national poet and the 'Bard of Avon'. His works consist of about 37 plays, 154 sonnets, and two long narrative poems.

name: Jane Austen
biography: English novelist known primarily for her six major novels, which interpret, critique and comment upon the British landed gentry at the end of the 18th century.

name: Leo Tolstoy
biography: Russian writer who primarily wrote novels and short stories. Tolstoy is widely considered one of the greatest authors of all time.

name: Virginia Woolf
biography: English writer, considered one of the most important modernist 20th-century authors and also a pioneer in the use of stream of consciousness as a narrative device.

name: Gabriel García Márquez
biography: Colombian novelist, short-story writer, screenwriter, and journalist, known affectionately as Gabo throughout Latin America.
